verdict.rationale: Teams is a SaaS collaboration product with Copilot AI features, so a control that keeps user data out of AI model training is a fair axis. The evidence pack has no documentation of a training opt-out or a no-training data policy. The Copilot docs only say it can 'securely interact' with work data, which says nothing about whether that data is used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
